Laura — thanks for the heads up. I can approve moving to a 45-day auto-renew notice as a commercial concession for this deal under the following guardrails: 

1) Termination for convenience must be scoped to the order form only, with explicit language that the MSA remains in force for other customers and that the order form termination refunds are pro-rated based on unused, prepaid service fees.
2) Limit our refund exposure: cap the pro-rated refund to the greater of (a) three months' fees or (b) the unused prepaid balance — whichever is lower. This prevents open-ended liability on large prepayments.
3) Include a one-time good-faith credit equal to one month's subscription fees if customer insists on 45 days. That credit is applied at the start of the next billing cycle and not refundable.
4) If Acme insists on termination applying to the MSA broadly, we refuse. Order-form only is acceptable.

Priyom/Karthik — please incorporate the above into the redline: a) 45-day notice acceptance clause, b) termination-for-convenience section scoped to the order form, c) explicit refund cap formula, and d) a clause referencing the one-time credit. Once redlines updated I will OK sending a DocuSign link.
